items.raw_excerpt: T.N. government suspends tahsildar for ordering collection of Communist party member details, prompting inquiry into his actions.
items.summary_en: A tahsildar in Tamil Nadu was suspended for ordering the collection of Communist party members' details. The state government has launched an inquiry into the official's actions.

items.title_original: Tahsildar in Dindigul suspended for ordering collection of CPI, CPI(M) members’ details

items.raw_excerpt: From longer internships to training in driver-assistance systems, polytechnics in Singapore are strengthening their curriculum to prepare students for a future with self-driving vehicles.
items.summary_en: Polytechnics in Singapore are strengthening their curriculum to prepare students for a future with self-driving vehicles. Programs now include longer internships and hands-on training in driver-assistance systems. The move aims to meet evolving industry needs in autonomous mobility.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르 폴리테크닉들이 자율주행차 시대에 대비해 교육 과정을 강화하고 있다. 인턴십 기간을 늘리고 운전 보조 시스템 실습을 확대해 업계 수요에 맞추고 있다. 자율 모빌리티 분야의 변화하는 요구에 선제적으로 대응하기 위한 조치이다.
items.title_en: Polytechnics boost autonomous vehicle training
items.title_ko: 폴리테크닉, 자율주행차 교육 강화
items.title_original: Polytechnics step up autonomous mobility training as industry needs evolve

items.raw_excerpt: Taboadella brings together wine tourism, history, and luxury accommodation at its estate in the Dão, where visitors can explore 42 hectares of vineyards, discover more than 1,500 years of winemaking history, and stay at a private Relais & Châteaux property.
items.summary_en: Taboadella is a wine estate in the Dão region of Portugal. Visitors can explore 42 hectares of vineyards and learn about over 1,500 years of winemaking history. The estate also offers stays at a private Relais & Châteaux property.
items.summary_ko: 타보아델라는 포르투갈 다오 지역의 와인 농장입니다. 방문객들은 42헥타르의 포도밭을 둘러보고 1,500년 이상의 와인 양조 역사를 배울 수 있습니다. 릴레 앤 샤또 소유의 숙박 시설도 이용 가능합니다.
items.title_en: Wine, History and Luxury Come Together at Taboadella
items.title_ko: 다오 지역 타보아델라에서 와인, 역사, 럭셔리가 만나다
items.title_original: Wine, history and luxury come together at Taboadella

items.raw_excerpt: Planning authorities decline a fiercely contested multimillion-dollar plan for Bunnings to build a new store 10km from its existing premises in Bunbury.
items.summary_en: Planning authorities in Western Australia have rejected a controversial multimillion-dollar plan for Bunnings to build a new store in Bunbury. The proposed megastore would have been located 10 kilometers from the company's existing store in the area. The decision ends a fierce debate about the development.
items.summary_ko: 서호주 계획 당국이 번버리에 새로운 빈닝스 매장을 건설하려는 수백만 달러 규모의 계획을 기각했습니다. 제안된 메가스토어는 기존 매장에서 10km 떨어진 곳에 지어질 예정이었습니다. 이 결정으로 해당 개발에 대한 치열한 논쟁이 마무리되었습니다.
items.title_en: Planners Reject New Bunnings Megastore in Bunbury
items.title_ko: 번버리 신규 빈닝스 메가스토어 계획 기각
items.title_original: Planners knock back controversial plan for new Bunnings megastore

items.raw_excerpt: The Telangana government plans renovation of the State Archaeology Museum in Hyderabad, focusing on conservation of Egyptian mummy and tourism enhancement.
items.summary_en: The Telangana state government plans to renovate the State Archaeology Museum in Hyderabad. The project includes conservation of an ancient Egyptian mummy. Officials say the renovation will also help boost tourism in the city.
items.summary_ko: 텔랑가나 주정부가 하이데라바드에 있는 주립 고고학 박물관의 리모델링을 추진하고 있습니다. 이번 사업에는 이집트 고대 미라 보존 작업도 포함되어 있습니다. 당국은 이번 공사가 관광 활성화에도 기여할 것으로 기대하고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Hyderabad museum set for renovation to protect Egyptian mummy
items.title_ko: 하이데라바드 고고학 박물관, 이집트 미라 보존과 함께 리모델링 추진
items.title_original: Plans afoot for renovation of Telangana State Archaeology Museum; Egyptian mummy conservation to cost ₹82 lakh

items.raw_excerpt: Katie Taylor's historic undisputed super lightweight title fight with Flora Pili next month at Croke Park will be available to watch live free-to-air with RTÉ Sport.
items.summary_en: Katie Taylor will have her final boxing match at Croke Park in Dublin next month. The historic undisputed super lightweight title fight against Flora Pili will be shown live on RTÉ Sport. This is a free-to-air broadcast for Irish fans.
items.summary_ko: 케이티 테일러는 다음 달 더블린의 크로크 파크에서 마지막 복싱 경기를 갖습니다. Flora Pili와의 슈퍼 라이트급 타이틀 경기는 RTÉ 스포츠에서 라이브로 중계됩니다. 아일랜드 팬들을 위한 무료 방송입니다.

items.raw_excerpt: The Department of Conservation (DOC) is appealing to the public for help after a popular campsite at Arthur's Pass in the South Island was torn up by 4WD vehicles.
items.summary_en: The Department of Conservation is asking for public help after 4WD vehicles damaged a popular campsite at Arthur's Pass in the South Island. DOC says the campsite was torn up by off-road vehicles. They are appealing to the public for any information.
items.summary_ko: 자원부는 남섬 아서스패스의 인기 캠핑장이 4WD 차량에 의해 훼손된 후 대중의 도움을 요청하고 있다. 캠핑장은 오프로드 차량들에 의해 망가졌다. 자원부는 대중에게 정보를 제공해달라고 호소하고 있다.
items.title_en: Arthur's Pass campsite torn up by 4WD vehicles

items.raw_excerpt: Long after sunset, Motoaki Iijima's illuminated greenhouse north of Tokyo glows like a lantern as the flower farmer harvests pink and orange gerberas, avoiding a daytime sun fierce enough to ‌be deadly. As increasingly intense heatwaves turn Japanese summers into survival tests, farmers — from flower and asparagus growers to…
items.summary_en: Flower farmer Motoaki Iijima harvests gerberas after dark in a glowing greenhouse north of Tokyo. Deadly daytime heatwaves are forcing Japanese farmers to shift their work to nighttime to stay safe. Growers across the country are adapting as summers become increasingly dangerous.
items.summary_ko: 도쿄 북쪽에서 꽃 농부 이지마 모토키는 화려하게 빛나는 온실에서 야간에 제라바를 수확하고 있다. 낮시간 치명적인 폭염이 극심해지면서 일본 농민들은 안전을 위해 작업 시간을 밤으로 옮기고 있다. 전국의 재배자들이 여름이 점점 위험해지면서 변화에 적응하고 있다.
items.title_en: Japanese farmers switch to nighttime work as dangerous heat gets worse
items.title_ko: 일본 농민, 치명적 폭염에 야간 작업으로 전환
items.title_original: Japan's farmers go nocturnal as deadly heat intensifies

items.summary_en: Car certificate of entitlement prices in Singapore rose in the latest bidding exercise. Category A premiums increased for the first time in three rounds, reaching more than S$128,500.

items.raw_excerpt: In Spain, every region, province, city and island has its own word for its inhabitants.
items.summary_en: Spain has many names for people from different regions. Every province, city, and island has its own word for its inhabitants. From Madrileños to Gaditanos the country is full of unique local nicknames.

items.raw_excerpt: Denmark's schools are now back in full flow after the summer holidays. Here's what some of our readers said were the best (and worst) aspects of going to school in the country.
items.summary_en: Denmark's schools have reopened after the summer break. Foreign parents shared their views on the best and worst parts of the Danish school system. The feedback covers both strengths and challenges.

items.raw_excerpt: Getting a glass of tap water with your meal may be routine elsewhere, but a new Vienna price check shows it's far from guaranteed in Austrian restaurants and cafés.
items.summary_en: A new price check in Vienna found that Austrian restaurants and cafés are allowed to charge customers for tap water. Getting free tap water with a meal is common in many countries, but not guaranteed in Austria.
items.summary_ko: 빈에서 실시한 최신 가격 조사에 따르면, 오스트리아 식당과 카페는 손님에게 수돗물 비용을 청구할 수 있는 것으로 확인됐다. 다른 나라에서는 식사와 함께 수돗물을 무료로 제공하는 것이 일반적이지만, 오스트리아에서는 그렇지 않다.
items.title_en: Can Austrian restaurants charge you for tap water?

items.summary_en: Sailing and boating let you enjoy Germany's lakes, rivers and northern seas. A German sailing instructor shares his favorite parts of sailing and how to earn a boating licence.

items.raw_excerpt: This French expression shows that being in a bad mood may have something to do with the moon.
items.summary_en: The French phrase être mal luné means being in a bad mood. The expression connects mood to the moon, similar to the English word lunatic. It is a common way to describe someone who is grumpy or out of sorts.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스어 표현 être mal luné는 기분이 나쁘다는 뜻이다. 이 표현은 영어의 lunatic처럼 달과 기분을 연결한다. 짜증이나 기분 나쁜 사람을 표현할 때 흔히 쓰인다.

items.raw_excerpt: Spain has seen an increase in drownings this year, but there's one place that has overhauled its lifeguard services and hasn't registered any tragedies so far this summer.
items.summary_en: Spain has had more drownings this year, but Alicante has not had any tragedies. The city improved its lifeguard services and safety measures. Other areas are now looking at what Alicante did differently.
items.summary_ko: 올해 스페인에서 해변 사고가 증가했지만, 알리칸테는 단 한 건의 사고도 발생하지 않았다. 이 도시는 안전요원 서비스와 안전 대책을 크게 개선했다. 이제 다른 지역들도 알리칸테의 성공 사례를 참고하고 있다.

items.raw_excerpt: The 'Rubber Boy of Kashmir' is the nickname given to Sayam Hyder, a contortionist, dancer and yoga instructor from North Kashmir who is twisting, bending and squeezing his way towards dreams of international recognition.
items.summary_en: Sayam Hyder from North Kashmir is known as the Rubber Boy for his amazing contortion skills. He can twist his head 180 degrees and squeeze his entire body through a tennis racket. He dreams of gaining international recognition for his unique talents.
